objective: Review the ready-only metadata boundary that lets a non-executing native-parser adapter-payload to sidecar plan-resolution result feed sidecar_handoff_contract metadata, while keeping runtime handoff execution, command synthesis, operator-plan production, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, and upstream landing claims out of scope.

review_decision.reason: The definition correctly narrows the next step to metadata construction from an already ready plan-resolution result. It requires the reviewed plan-resolution surface, outer ready_for_verilator_option_shim status, ready_for_direct_verilator_option true, planned stage_plan status, matching parser and stage shapes, and coverage_output_equivalence as a reference policy before sidecar_handoff_contract metadata may be built.
review_decision.weakest_point: sidecar_handoff_contract can still be over-read as sidecar runtime handoff validation, correctness evidence, or command readiness. The next implementation must therefore remain non-executing, must not synthesize commands or operator plans, and must treat parser-preserved inputs only as audit and cross-check fields rather than source closure, report paths, compare labels, host-probe metadata, or allocation authorities.

required_next_implementation.name: implement_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_handoff_contract_fixture_gate
must_implement: add an importable helper in the existing plan-resolution module that consumes a resolved plan-resolution mapping
reject results whose surface is not native_verilator_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_fixture
reject results whose outer status is not ready_for_verilator_option_shim
reject results whose plan_resolution_readiness.ready_for_direct_verilator_option is not true
reject results whose plan_resolution_readiness.stage_plan_status or stage_plan.status is not planned
reject results whose readiness status is not ready_for_verilator_option_shim
reject results whose parser_schedule_constraints.shape does not equal stage_plan.shape
call sidecar_handoff_contract(stage_plan) only after all ready-only checks pass

return a non-executing fixture result with handoff metadata and explicit flags showing no command synthesis, operator plan, execution, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI change, source closure inference, arbitrary filelist expansion, or automatic allocation

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not command synthesis from native parser payload
not operator-plan production from native parser payload
not coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
not a new public CLI or workflow
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
